# Dev only (epic 2 story 3): switch the dev kind and asset adapter
	# (project library mapstudio_dev) to mode ok, then ask Map Studio to call
	# both functions now. refreshAdapters waits for the calls to answer or time out.
	import java.lang

	logger = system.util.getLogger('MapStudio.devadapter')
	out = self.view.rootContainer.getChild('adapterResult')

	# The buttons change test equipment for every session, so only a map editor may
	# press them (the same role check as the /edit page's script checks).
	roles = []
	try:
		if self.session.props.auth.authenticated:
			roles = [str(r) for r in (self.session.props.auth.user.roles or [])]
	except java.lang.Throwable as ex:
		roles = []
	except Exception as ex:
		roles = []
	if 'MapEditor' not in roles:
		out.props.text = system.util.jsonEncode({'refused': 'Switching the dev adapter needs the MapEditor role. Sign in as a map editor first.'})
		return

	try:
		mapstudio_dev.set_mode('ok')
		result = system.mapstudio.refreshAdapters(system.util.getProjectName())
		out.props.text = system.util.jsonEncode({'mode': 'ok', 'kinds': result['kinds'], 'assets': result['assets'],
			'calls': mapstudio_dev.calls()})
	except java.lang.Throwable as ex:
		logger.warn('Dev adapter refresh failed: %s' % ex.getClass().getSimpleName())
		out.props.text = system.util.jsonEncode({'error': ex.getMessage()})
	except Exception as ex:
		logger.warn('Dev adapter refresh failed: %s' % type(ex).__name__)
		out.props.text = system.util.jsonEncode({'error': str(ex)})

	import java.lang

	logger = system.util.getLogger('MapStudio.devadapter')
	out = self.view.rootContainer.getChild('adapterResult')

	# The buttons change test equipment for every session, so only a map editor may
